Python: if / elif / else
Python: conditional expression
y = a if x > 0 else b
C-style languages (C, C++, Java, C#, JavaScript, ...): if / else if / else
C-style languages (C, C++, Java, C#, JavaScript, ...): ternary conditional operator
y = x > 0 ? a : b;
C preprocessor: conditional compilation

#if X > 0
...
#elif X < 0
...
#else
...
#endif
Go, Rust, Swift: if / else if / else (no parentheses, braces required)
Go: if with an initializer statement
Rust: if let (pattern-matching conditional)
Swift: guard (early-exit conditional)
Kotlin: when without a subject (if/else-if chain)
Kotlin and Scala: if as an expression (no ternary operator)
val y = if (x > 0) a else b
Bash / POSIX shell: if / elif / else

if [ "$x" -gt 0 ]; then
  a
elif [ "$x" -lt 0 ]; then
  b
else
  c
fi
Ruby: if / elsif / else

if x > 0
  a
elsif x < 0
  b
else
  c
end
Perl: if / elsif / else
PHP: if / elseif / else
Lua: if / elseif / else

if x > 0 then
  a()
elseif x < 0 then
  b()
else
  c()
end
MATLAB / Octave and Julia: if / elseif / else

if x > 0
  a()
elseif x < 0
  b()
else
  c()
end
Visual Basic (VB.NET, VBA): If / ElseIf / Else

If x > 0 Then
    A()
ElseIf x < 0 Then
    B()
Else
    C()
End If
Ada (also VHDL, PL/SQL): if / elsif / else
Fortran: if / else if / else

if (x > 0) then
  call a()
else if (x < 0) then
  call b()
else
  call c()
end if
Haskell: guards

f x
  | x > 0     = a

Common Lisp (also Emacs Lisp): cond
Scheme / Racket: cond
Clojure: cond

(cond

  (< x 0) (b)
  :else (c))
Erlang: if expression
Elixir: cond

  x > 0 -> a()
  x < 0 -> b()
  true -> c()
end
